Raththam (2026) | South Hindi Dubbed Movie | Vijay Antony, Nandita Swetha | Crime Action Movies

Synopsis
The Triggering Event: Chezhiyan, the editor of a prominent media house and a close friend/brother-figure to ace investigative journalist Ranjith Kumar, is brutally murdered inside his office. The killer is initially identified as an enraged fan of a superstar actor who lashed out after Chezhiyan published a critical article about the star.
Ranjith's Return: At the time of the murder, Ranjith Kumar has withdrawn from active journalism and is living as a secluded, grieving single father/alcoholic in Kolkata following his wife's tragic death. Chezhiyan's father and Ranjith's former boss, Rathna Pandian, travels to Kolkata to beg Ranjith to return to Chennai and take over the editor's chair.
Uncovering the Conspiracy: Ranjith reluctantly returns to Chennai. While looking into Chezhiyan’s murder, he realizes that the crime is not an isolated act of fan fanaticism. Instead, he uncovers a larger, sinister, and coordinated murder-for-hire / hate-crime network that manipulates social media, brainwashes impressionable youth, and stages seemingly "clear-cut" public crimes to serve hidden agendas.
Climax: Ranjith uses his investigative prowess and psychological profiling skills to trace the hidden puppet masters behind these orchestrated killings before more innocent lives are lost.

Plot Overview
The Setup: Raja Huli (Yash) is a carefree, degree-graduate son of a rich landlord in Mandya who spends his time helping his close friends.
The Twist: When his friend Moni asks him to help convey his love to a college girl named Kaveri (Meghana Raj), Raja agrees, only to discover that Kaveri is his own ex-girlfriend.
The Complications: Instead of accepting Moni's proposal, Kaveri confesses that she still loves Raja. This sparks jealousy and friction among Raja’s friends and other suitors who were also vying for Kaveri.
The False Accusation: A fatal incident and murder occur involving another man who loved Kaveri, and the blame is falsely placed on Raja.
The Climax: Raja must navigate shifting loyalties, figure out who is trying to frame him, and clear his name while fighting to win back his relationship.

recentItems.description:
Mission 118 (2026) | South Hindi Dubbed Movie | Kalyan Ram, Shalini Pandey | Indian Thriller Movie

Synopsis
While staying in Room 118 of a resort, Gowtham experiences a vivid, terrifying nightmare at 1:18 AM. In the dream, he witnesses a young woman being brutally beaten by a group of thugs and thrown against a painting. Though he initially dismisses it, the exact same dream haunts him months later when he encounters the same room and time setup.
Driven by his investigative instincts, Gowtham suspects the vision is a form of lucid dreaming tied to a real-life crime. Assisted by his fiancée Megha (Shalini Pandey), he begins piecing together the fragmented clues from his dream. His investigation leads him to discover that the woman in his nightmare is Aadhya (Nivetha Thomas), a real person who has mysteriously vanished.
As Gowtham digs deeper into Aadhya’s past, he uncovers a massive, dangerous corporate conspiracy involving a medical scam orchestrated by powerful elites. The second half of the movie transitions into a race against time as Gowtham uses his journalistic skills and physical grit to expose the culprits, bringing closure to Aadhya's tragic fate.
